diagnosis.conclusion: The retained exact 8x4 leaf restored dense raw Q8 to first in the 4K Amdahl ledger. It still reread each activation row once per eight output columns, leaving an exact output-column reuse opportunity.

change.summary: Widen exact raw-Q8 prefill from eight to sixteen output columns while retaining four-row activation reuse and every scalar dot association.
change.fallback: Measured short-row shapes keep exact 8x4 (or the earlier 8x2/pack8 policy); widths not divisible by sixteen keep the existing exact route; explicit WMMA retains precedence.
change.exactness: Each accumulator retains k=tid+128*n traversal, the same wave32 shuffle tree, and the same wave-0..3 cross-wave addition. Only independent output columns are interleaved.
change.rejected_candidate: The exact 8x8 row-reuse candidate was 0.81% to 31.34% slower than 8x4 at every production shape and was removed before retention.
